nom: numbuzin No.9 NAD+ Peptide Serum for Face

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one with a very oily T-zone, report the serum absorbs without feeling sticky or greasy, though one reviewer with combination-to-oily skin found it too heavy and left her skin very shiny.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with medication-thinned, dehydrated skin and another with parched winter skin, consistently report the serum absorbs well and leaves skin noticeably more hydrated and plump.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report a lightweight, hydrating feel they prefer over heavier oiliness, though one with combination-to-oily skin found the formula too heavy and shine-inducing.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some prone to irritation or fragrance sensitivity, report no irritation and good hydration, but one reviewer describes an intense itchy rash after use.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin, including one managing age-related fine lines, texture and pigmentation concerns, report a new glow and visible improvement in their skin's appearance.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin, including one with post-menopausal dry skin, report gradual but noticeable improvement in firmness, elasticity and fine lines with consistent use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report firmer, plumper skin and visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles after consistent use, often citing the peptide and NAD+ content, but one reviewer says it made her under-eye bags and wrinkles look worse, and another saw no visible difference after 13 nights of use.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most consistently reported benefit, with reviewers describing plumper, softer, glowing skin, including one whose medication-thinned skin retained moisture noticeably better.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the serum reduced redness overnight after a bad breakout, alongside less puffiness and softer fine lines.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with early-40s skin reports the serum does not cause breakouts, and another says it helped calm and rehydrate skin that had been left dry and irritated by a recent breakout.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including some with an oily T-zone or oily skin, say the serum absorbs without feeling sticky or greasy, but one reviewer with combination-to-oily skin found it too heavy, leaving her skin very shiny.

aspects.libelle: Thick, gel-like texture that melts in without stickiness

extraits.titre: On My Third Bottle - Great For Mature SkinOn My Third Bottle - Great For Mature Skin
extraits.texte: At 52 with post-menopausal dry, mature skin, I’m constantly looking for products that support skin quality, elasticity, and long-term aging rather than just quick, temporary fixes. The numbuzin No.9 NAD+ Peptide Lifting Serum has become one of those rare products that I continue to repurchase — I’m currently on my third bottle, which says a lot. I’ve been especially interested in NAD+ as a topical ingredient, which has been gaining attention for its potential role in supporting skin energy, resilience, and overall skin health. While topical NAD+ isn’t going to create dramatic overnight changes, what it can do — and what this serum does very well — is improve overall skin quality, hydration, and firmness over time. The texture is excellent. It’s lightweight but slightly cushiony, almost like a silky essence-serum hybrid. It spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and layers beautifully with other products. Despite being lightweight, it still provides noticeable hydration, which is especially important for my dry, mature skin. What I’ve noticed most with consistent use is that my skin looks smoother, more refined, and more resilient. It’s not an instant dramatic change, but rather a gradual improvement in overall skin tone, bounce, and elasticity. These are exactly the types of results I look for at this stage — subtle but meaningful improvements over time. The formula also includes 50 peptides, which complement the NAD+ beautifully. Together, they create a serum focused on long-term

I always search for anti-aging but moisturizing products to prevent wrinkles and help hydration. this product seemed good for that and I was right: the composition is very rich, very hydrating, but not sticky or greasy. I used it for like 10 days during my night care routine, and the next morning my skin was softer and glowing. I highly really recommend it

Wow. Honestly, wow. This skincare product has been nothing but great and I mean it. The 50 Peptide + NDA formula is extremely potent and offers quick results a cheap price point. To go into more detail, it offers various branches of peptides, some that occur naturally in the body , like signaling peptides (which over time stimulate collagen) , so this product quite literally develops collagen , reinforcing it with NDA+. Along with those, it offers hydrating peptides with work at a molecular level to hydrate the skin. I had a bad breakout a week ago, and have been suffering with dry skin due to issues on dealing with the breakout, and this serum quite literally fixed it overnight. All I did was apply this along with other serums, and by morning time I noticed a reduction in redness, plumpiness of the skin which ultimately helped reduce fine lines, and hydration. This product is great for anyone with sensitive skin, heck if it can help someone with a breakout, what cant it do?! With that said, its also great if your skin is sensitive to fragrances, as it offers ZERO fragrance, all natural ingredients, and last you enough for about a month and a half. If your contemplating on buying this product, its a no brainer, GET IT. The presentation and packaging , along with the actual ease of incorporating to your skincare routine, and the BENEFITS will wow you.
